messages:
maria: seeing repeated pod evictions on eu-west1-gpu nodes starting ~09:12, looks correlated with short ENI flaps. Pods with gpu-sidecar (nvlink-proxy) lose network, kubelet marks NotReady, then scheduler rebinds; cluster fragmentation spikes.

kai: saw same. node1-azb had 3 flaps in 2m, kubelet logs show: 
```
E0904 09:12:11.123 kubelet.go:184] Network plugin lost: error fetching status: connection reset by peer
```

ops-bot: incident created #INC-4321 (severity: low) — auto-collecting node logs.

danielle: quick data point: affected pods tend to be large-slot (4gpus) long-lived jobs. After eviction they land on different shards and we get unusable small-slot leftovers -> fragmentation.

maria: hypothesis: ENI traffic spike + CNI throughput limit triggers NV sidecar to hit tcp timeout, kube-proxy churns, then healthchecks fail. Anyone captured dmesg or CNI logs?

josh: grabbed logs from node1-azb: 
```
Sep 04 09:12:10 kernel: mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: firmware hwrm command timeout
Sep 04 09:12:11 cni-plugin[5478]: failed to program rules: tx-queue full
```

kai: mlx5 firmware timeouts ring a bell — we've seen similar when NIC drivers get saturated by bursts (model download + checkpoint upload). Could be egress hotspots from large workloads hitting same ENI.

danielle: mitigation ideas: 1) temp: cordon and migrate clustered large-slot jobs to reserved compact pool (we have spare capacity in dedicated-gpu-compact), 2) reduce kubelet eviction aggressiveness for those jobs (increase grace period), 3) long-term: add ENI autoscale/attach balancing or break up large-slot placement to reduce per-ENI egress.

maria: agreed. I'll cordon node1-azb and start drain to compact pool. Also will create a quick alert on ENI tx-queue saturation metric.

josh: also propose bumping CNI mtu/tx-queue and rolling NIC driver to 5.16.2 on a canary node — we saw stability improvement in staging.

kai: one more note: descheduler currently runs hourly; during this churn it might be re-creating fragmentation. Suggest pausing descheduler for 20m while we rebalance to avoid thrash.

maria: action items: 
- cordon/drain node1-azb -> danielle (in flight)
- create ENI tx-queue alert -> maria
- force canary NIC driver upgrade on one compact node -> josh
- pause descheduler for eu-west1 during remediation -> kai

ops-bot: reminder: please add rollback plan to the upgrade ticket. :thumbsup:

danielle: done on the cordon, moving 2 jobs to compact pool now. Will report back when fragmentation metrics (free contiguous slots) improve.

maria: thanks — I’ll follow up with a short postmortem if we confirm root cause.
